about: Findings of suite_structure_gate.py that stay, each with its reason. kind: client (a version or client guard; the reason names the client), addon (another addon's export), lod (an export of a load-on-demand Suite addon), state (saved variables or runtime state), review (in another pass's files, not yet confirmed by its owner).

P.W is the external MSUF Menu2 widget API. Newer hosts support separate summaries and full help; older hosts receive the complete original paragraph. suite_options_menu_contract covers both versions.

Blizzard_ItemUpgradeUI is load on demand; ItemUpgradeFrame exists only after it loads, so the helper waits for its ADDON_LOADED.

MSUF's unit and group frame tooltip mode marks GameTooltip with this field while it owns the tooltip (MidnightSimpleUnitFrames Runtime/MSUF_UnitTooltips.lua) and clears it on hide or the next SetOwner; MSUF's own visibility setting then wins.
Blizzard_PlayerSpells loads on demand; while it shows another player's talents (IsInspecting) the shared inspect buffer is busy and the opt-in hover request waits.

Blizzard_InspectUI loads on demand, so InspectFrame exists only after the first inspect. The tooltip shows the open window's unit level after its INSPECT_READY, and the separate inspectHovered opt-in sends its own requests only while this window is closed and idle.
The shared native stack-split window has no item owner when closed or used without an inventory slot.

Forever has no C_ItemUpgrade (no modern equipment upgrades); Retail 12.1.0 and 12.1.5 read upgradeCostTypesForSeason (upstream/live ItemUpgradeDocumentation.lua) only after a native upgrade item was observed. suite_datatexts_sources_contract formats the Crests place without C_ItemUpgrade (unknown season) and with it.

LibDataBroker-1.1 is another addon's library, reached through LibStub when some addon loaded it; the Suite bundles neither. suite_datatexts_sources_contract covers plugins and callbacks with the library and, without LibStub, an empty plugin list, no callback registration and the configured name with the placeholder.

Blizzard_ProfessionsBook is Blizzard's load-on-demand UI (upstream/live Blizzard_ProfessionsBook defines ProfessionsBookFrame); the Professions place requests it and toggles the frame only once it exists. suite_datatexts_sources_contract covers the missing and the loaded book.

LearnedDungeonPortals is exported by the optional, load-on-demand QualityOfLife addon (DungeonPortals.lua). The portal place requests that addon and opens nothing while the export is missing; suite_datatexts_security_contract covers the missing export and the secure portal rows.

A LibDataBroker-1.1 data object belongs to another addon and its OnClick handler is optional in the LDB spec; it runs through S.Dispatch. suite_datatexts_sources_contract clicks a plugin with OnClick (also in combat).
A LibDataBroker-1.1 data object belongs to another addon and its OnEnter handler is optional in the LDB spec; a plugin with it shows its own tooltip (suite_datatexts_sources_contract).
A LibDataBroker-1.1 data object belongs to another addon and its OnLeave handler is optional in the LDB spec (suite_datatexts_sources_contract).

A LibDataBroker-1.1 data object belongs to another addon and its OnTooltipShow handler is optional in the LDB spec; with it the plugin fills the Suite's GameTooltip, without it the Suite shows the place's own lines (suite_datatexts_sources_contract).

MSUF publishes the global font flags through ExportPublic in Castbars/MSUF_Castbars_Core.lua (Main and Classic hosts). The 'MSUF outline' choice uses them; an MSUF build without that export gets the Suite outline table.

MSUF publishes the global font path through ExportPublic in Castbars/MSUF_Castbars_Core.lua (Main and Classic hosts). An empty nameplate font key follows it; an MSUF build without that export resolves the key through the Suite font registry.

MSUF's boss target renderer (UnitFrames/Engine/Elements/MSUF_UF_BossTargetIndicator.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) draws the nameplate target arrows and their preview; an MSUF build without it shows no arrows. suite_nameplates_contract and suite_options_menu_contract load the real renderer.

P.M is MSUF2 (Menu/Bridge.lua). RegisterControlMetadata (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_ControlCatalog.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) adds search and keyboard metadata to the enemy tabs; without it the tabs work unregistered.
NameplatesEditor.lua Editor.Create sets it only when the page builds a nameplate preview (W.FixedPreviewSection returned a section); the Blizzard elements tab also opens without a preview to switch.

P.W is MSUF2's widget table. SegmentTabs is a Menu2 widget (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Widgets.lua on the Main and Classic hosts); an MSUF build without it gets the enemy design and the Blizzard elements as two ordinary sections.

H is MSUF2.PreviewHelpers (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua on the Main and Classic hosts, {} without it). ApplyPreviewChrome gives the canvas the shared preview frame; without it the canvas stays plain.

MSUF2.PreviewHelpers export (MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua, Main and Classic hosts). Arrow nudges stop while a menu text input has focus; without it the GetCurrentKeyBoardFocus EditBox check below still applies.
MSUF2.PreviewHelpers export (MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua, Main and Classic hosts) that tells the host preview history about a drag; without it the move is only saved.
MSUF2.PreviewHelpers export (MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua, Main and Classic hosts) with the host's nudge step; without it the editor uses Ctrl 10, Shift 5, otherwise 1 pixel.
MSUF2.PreviewHelpers export (MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua, Main and Classic hosts) paired with FocusKeyboardTarget; without the pair no keyboard capture exists to release.
MSUF2.PreviewHelpers export (MSUF_Menu2_PreviewHelpers.lua, Main and Classic hosts) that drops a key repeat delivered twice by the host bindings; without it every delivery nudges.
MSUF2 export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_API.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) that scrolls to one setting row; without it a handle click selects the element without opening its setting.
MSUF2 export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Support.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) that routes arrow keys to the selected preview; without it the body's own OnKeyDown handles them.
MSUF2 theme export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Theme.lua on the Main and Classic hosts); without it the toolbar labels keep the theme button's alignment.
MSUF2 widget export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Widgets.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) that opens and flashes a section; without it a right-click only opens the setting.

Layer chips made by MSUF2.PreviewHelpers.CreateLayerButton (Main and Classic hosts) repaint themselves through Refresh; the plain T.Button fallback for an MSUF build without that helper has none and is dimmed by alpha.
NameplatesSize.Build adds it only when MSUF2's PreviewSelectionBar exists (BuildSelection); without that bar there is no size row to refresh.
not in the UI source: GlobalStrings (STANDARD_TEXT_FONT) are absent from the mirror, so the preview keeps Blizzard's default face as its fallback path

MSUF2 widget export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Widgets.lua on the Main and Classic hosts) that asks whether a docked preview opens expanded; without it the preview keeps its fixed size when the page activates.
MSUF2.PreviewSelectionBar (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_PreviewSelectionBar.lua on the Main and Classic hosts); without it the preview has no selection bar to show or hide.
MSUF2 theme export (Shell/Menu2/MSUF_Menu2_Theme.lua on the Main and Classic hosts); without it the size fields keep the default edit box look.
The ActionBars addon loads on its own and exports this visitor only once loaded; without it the celebration plays without spinning bars. suite_party_effects_contract covers both cases.
Blizzard_InspectUI loads on demand, so InspectFrame and its gear slots exist only after the first inspect; slot icon cropping waits for its ADDON_LOADED and then crops on every InspectFrame show.
Blizzard_AuctionHouseUI loads on demand, so AuctionHouseFrame exists only after the first auction house visit; the filter hint waits for its ADDON_LOADED.

the addon's own SavedVariables table of learned demon looks: nil until the first look is learned (saved variables arrive after the files ran); suite_buff_reminders_restored_contract covers the empty start
